references.text: The description of the tabernacle's planks, crossbars, pillars, and bases that the sons of Merari were responsible for carrying.
The execution of the work to make the planks, crossbars, pillars, and bases of the tabernacle.
The earlier assignment of responsibility to the sons of Merari for the tabernacle's planks, crossbars, pillars, and bases.
The sons of Merari were given four carts and eight oxen to transport the heavy parts of the tabernacle.
The sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari carried the tabernacle when the Israelites broke camp.
